hold_text: HELD for the manager: Tier 2 change to the VM secret-sync wrapper (sync_vm_secrets.sh) and rotate_account_keys.sh; the .env write path changes from sed to awk. Not run against the VM.
why: _patch_env_var used '|' as its sed delimiter without escaping it, so an UPDATE of an existing secret whose value contains '|' corrupted or failed the line. Values are now written literally via awk ENVIRON. Closes PI-20260930-BHYHMK2C-0001 once merged.
